source_mode: Finite diagnostic of existing authorized CC0 skin and rifle; no new art or geometry

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Offline 3D pose inspection only; no publishable asset

source_brief: Distinguish incorrect curl axes/skin evaluation from palm-to-foreend geometry mismatch using weighted skin derivatives.
alpha_policy: Opaque diagnostic screenshots; no chroma-key output.
requirements: Use only sealed primary final calibration and reviewed real pad face IDs. Baseline full reach must exactly reproduce its sealed report, treating signed zero as identical.
For each joint control only its final curl command, baseline minus one degree and plus one degree, in that order. Retain splay, distal curls, all other fingers, body and right-hand commands.
Record actual pad vertices, four original skin indices/weights, joint origin/effective world axis, nearest visible weapon triangle/normal and gap components.
Compare actual central differences in mm/degree to the exact weighted linear blend skinning derivative and separately to the naive rigid whole-vertex approximation.
Expected effective axis uses cached rest visual-to-bone conversion and baseline posed quaternion; compare to the observed minus-to-plus world quaternion rotation.
Keep weapon, hand/palm, right hand and non-left-finger bone matrices fixed; allow only controlled joint and descendants. Verify all restored matrices/vertices, topology, weights and parentage.
Measure gap derivative toward the frozen baseline closest surface point; report nearest-face switching separately. Do not infer containment from nearest signed distance.
Record bone lengths and actual nearby foreend triangle extent in weapon-local coordinates; do not assume one scalar hand scale explains contact.
One baseline and sixteen prescribed perturbations, then restore. No optimizer, new anchor/rotation sweep, extra perturbation or candidate export.
This is a local diagnostic, not proof of global grip feasibility or approval of a runtime character. Preserve failed/partial output with no silent repeat.

One extra baseline replay after the v1 preflight missing-field failure; v1 had zero nonzero perturbations. V2 adds the original forearmTorso comparison and per-pose exact geometry/weights checks. No change to the 16-state domain.

derived_section_protocol.source: same saved baseline + original rifle GLB only
derived_section_protocol.sections: four proximal area-weighted centers at their saved local z
derived_section_protocol.coplanarPolicy: any fully coplanar face makes nearest section distance unknown; retain geometry and counts
derived_section_protocol.interpretation: same-z XY nearest distance only; MCP/palm markers projected from own z; no contact/containment/feasibility claim
